lede_cn: 2008 年 9 月到 2009 年 3 月,XLF 累计下跌 -84%——这是这个行业整个现代史上最深的一次回撤。五家头部金融机构在这次危机中消失:Bear Stearns 被 JPM 接管,Lehman 直接申请破产,Wamu 被 FDIC 关闭后由 JPM 接管,Wachovia 被 Wells Fargo 吞并,AIG 被联邦政府救助但股价归零。另外五家挺过来,且大多在此后十年里通过吞并失败者扩张了版图。
lede_en: Between September 2008 and March 2009, XLF fell -84% — the deepest drawdown in the sector's modern history. Five top financial institutions were extinguished by the crisis: Bear Stearns was absorbed by JPMorgan, Lehman filed for bankruptcy, Washington Mutual was seized by the FDIC and sold to JPM, Wachovia was acquired by Wells Fargo, and AIG was rescued by the federal government with shareholders essentially wiped out. Five others survived — and most expanded by absorbing the fallen.

casualties.name: Bear Stearns
casualties.note_cn: 第一张倒下的多米诺;周日深夜联储敲定 JPM 接管,初始报价 $2/股。
casualties.note_en: The first domino. The Fed sealed the JPM takeover late Sunday night at an initial $2/share.

casualties.name: Lehman Brothers
casualties.note_cn: 全球金融危机的引爆点;申请破产那一周 LIBOR-OIS 利差爆表,系统性危机正式开始。
casualties.note_en: The detonator of the global crisis. LIBOR-OIS exploded the week of the filing; systemic crisis officially began.

casualties.name: Washington Mutual
casualties.note_cn: 美国历史上最大的银行倒闭案,$307B 资产;FDIC 当晚就把它卖给了 JPM。
casualties.note_en: The largest bank failure in US history at $307B in assets. FDIC sold it to JPM that same evening.

casualties.name: Wachovia
casualties.note_cn: Golden West 次级贷款组合拖垮了它;Wells Fargo 在 Citi 出价后抢走了它。
casualties.note_en: The Golden West subprime portfolio sank it. Wells Fargo outbid Citi for the carcass.

casualties.name: AIG
casualties.note_cn: $182B 救助;股价从 $1457 跌到 $6,事实上股东归零。CDS 业务是核心病根。
casualties.note_en: A $182B rescue. The share price fell from $1,457 to $6 — shareholders effectively wiped out. The CDS book was the core wound.

survivors.name: JPMorgan Chase
survivors.note_cn: 危机中收购了 Bear 和 Wamu,从此奠定全美第一大银行地位;Jamie Dimon 一战封神。
survivors.note_en: Acquired both Bear and Wamu through the crisis; cemented its #1 US bank position. Jamie Dimon's defining moment.

survivors.name: Goldman Sachs
survivors.note_cn: 9 月转为银行控股公司,获得联储贴现窗口;巴菲特 Berkshire 同期注入 $50 亿优先股。
survivors.note_en: Converted to a bank holding company in September to access the Fed discount window; Buffett's Berkshire injected $5B of preferred at the same time.

survivors.name: Morgan Stanley
survivors.note_cn: 与高盛同周转为银行控股公司;三菱 UFJ 注入 $90 亿股权,是这次救援最有戏剧性的一笔。
survivors.note_en: Converted alongside Goldman the same week; Mitsubishi UFJ's $9B equity injection was the most dramatic single move of the rescue.

survivors.name: Bank of America
survivors.note_cn: 在危机最低点收购 Merrill Lynch,这桩生意成了 BAC 多年的负担;股价直到 2015 年才回到 $18。
survivors.note_en: Acquired Merrill Lynch at the bottom — the deal weighed on BAC for years; share price didn't reach $18 again until 2015.

survivors.name: Wells Fargo
survivors.note_cn: 通过吞并 Wachovia 一跃成为美国全国性零售银行;后来的「账户造假」丑闻是这次扩张的副作用。
survivors.note_en: Became a true nationwide retail bank by absorbing Wachovia; the later 'fake accounts' scandal traces partly to that aggressive expansion.

post_crisis_cn: 危机后的金融板块结构性变化:Dodd-Frank 法案(2010)强制银行降杠杆、剥离自营交易;Basel III 把核心资本充足率门槛拉到 8% 以上;最大五家投行就此消失了三家——Bear、Lehman、Merrill。今天的 XLF 已经不是 2007 年的 XLF。
post_crisis_en: Structural changes that followed: Dodd-Frank (2010) forced deleveraging and stripped out prop trading; Basel III pushed CET1 minimums above 8%; and three of the top-five investment banks — Bear, Lehman, Merrill — were gone. Today's XLF is not 2007's XLF.
